capabilities: add comments to notes using a dedicated callout syntax
list all comments in the current file in a sidebar view
add subcomments and remove comments from the sidebar
navigate to a comment's location by clicking it
hide comments in reading mode and exported documents
extras: README lists unfinished improvements (hide-behaviour setting, automatic name setting) as open todos.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach Word-style comments to notes for reviewing and discussing content with others.
summary: Comment plugin that stores comments as callouts in notes and lists them in a sidebar view for team collaboration.
